subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu bot-authored events become default-off on upgrade, requiring existing bot-to-bot installations to set channels.feishu.allowBots to true?
rationale: Current main can process bot-authored events when Feishu delivers them, while this PR intentionally introduces an admission gate whose absent value rejects them; tests cannot decide whether that compatibility change is the desired product policy.

options.title: Approve safe default-off
options.body: Require explicit allowBots: true, document the upgrade action, refresh checks, and land the current safety-oriented behavior.

options.title: Preserve implicit admission
options.body: Default existing installations to bot admission and reserve allowBots: false as the explicit opt-out, reducing upgrade breakage but increasing loop exposure by default.

recommendation.title: Approve safe default-off
recommendation.body: Require explicit allowBots: true, document the upgrade action, refresh checks, and land the current safety-oriented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He assigned the PR and authored the current implementation commits, making him the strongest available owner for the final compatibility policy.
